title: EIA Daily Generation Mix by Fuel Type
description: Daily US grid generation mix - coal (COL), natural gas (NG), nuclear (NUC), oil (OIL), other (OTH), solar (SUN), hydro (WAT), wind (WND). Each row reports latest day's generation MWh, share of total generation %, change vs same-day-prior-week %, change vs same-day-prior-year %, and a regime flag (RECORD_HIGH / ELEVATED / NORMAL / SOFT / RECORD_LOW based on 1-year percentile). Investment thesis maps to ICLN / TAN / FAN for clean energy, KOL for coal, UNG for nat gas. Powers the Energy & Grid Intelligence Brief's renewable / fuel-mix block.
